headline: Israel Allegedly Plotted to Kill Iranian Negotiators Mid-U.S. Peace Talks
summary: The alleged Israeli assassination plot against Iranian negotiators fractures voices between those urging diplomacy and those treating Iran as an unambiguous enemy.

voices.quote: America had to warn Iran that our so-called ally was trying to kill their negotiators. We don’t want that because we want to get to peace. Israel thinks we’ll be forced back into war if they do that.

Wow!

Let this sink in: After the first round of US-Iran talks in Islamabad, US intelligence picked up that Israel was planning to assassinate the Iranian negotiators as they were returning to Tehran.
